question_as_asked: List the names of all the cards in the set Hour of Devastation and find the formats in which these cards are legal.

question.question_text: List the names of all the cards in the set Hour of Devastation and find the formats in which these cards are legal.
question.evidence_text: the set Hour of Devastation refers to set.name = 'Hour of Devastation'; names of all the cards in the set refers to cards.name; legal cards refers to status = 'Legal'; the formats refers to format

executed_sql:
SELECT c.name, l.format 
FROM cards c 
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid 
WHERE c.setcode IN (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Hour of Devastation') AND l.status = 'Legal';
